lineas.texto: You wake up in the year 1300, in a small English village.
Your bed is a sack stuffed with straw. It smells like hay, and it itches.
There is no clock. The church bell tells you the day has begun.
In the middle of the house, a fire is already burning. There is no chimney. The smoke slips out through the roof.
Breakfast is dark bread and a cup of ale. It is weak, and everyone drinks it, even the children.
Outside, the fields are waiting. Almost everyone you know is a farmer.
And some days, you must work the lord's land for free.
Candles cost money. So when the sun goes down, your day is over.
